versions.changelog:
advisor-board-pro 1.0.0 introduces a comprehensive enterprise decision-making tool with advanced expert collaboration and reporting features.

- Access to all 36 top business advisors (including Chinese strategists, economists, investors, tech experts)
- Enhanced deep search with industry data, competitor analysis, and policy sources
- Full 11-step diagnosis workflow for thorough business analysis
- Exportable reports in PDF, Word, and Markdown, with customizable templates
- Team collaboration: multi-user sessions, comments, decision tracking, and shared history
- Add custom company advisors based on corporate values or industry expertise
- Priority support and enterprise customization options available
- Special early bird pricing and 7-day trial offered
